prompt: Implement a modular Enterprise Blockchain Ledger in C# with three isolated modules: (1) Transaction Pool managing cryptographic signatures and unspent output verification, (2) Block Miner executing proof-of-work hashing puzzles, and (3) Chain Validator verifying cryptographic hash linking across blocks.

criterion_scores.name: Module 1 Pool Score
criterion_scores.justification: Verifies signatures but uses insecure deterministic derivation instead of proper asymmetric cryptography, failing to meet enterprise security standards.

criterion_scores.name: Module 2 Miner Score
criterion_scores.justification: Correctly implements proof-of-work with adaptive nonce adjustment and difficulty targeting, though lacks parallel mining optimizations.

criterion_scores.name: Module 3 Validator Score
criterion_scores.justification: Thoroughly checks hash integrity, chain linkage, and difficulty compliance at every block level.

criterion_scores.name: System Integration Score
criterion_scores.justification: Functional end-to-end workflow with tampering detection, but lacks real-world consensus mechanisms and state synchronization checks.
